description: Implementation of D3D9-specific wrapper classes for render targets, including TextureRenderTarget9 and SurfaceRenderTarget9, managing Direct3D surfaces and textures for rendering.

classes.name: TextureRenderTarget9
classes.description: A wrapper for a D3D9 texture and surface used as a render target.

classes.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9
classes.description: A wrapper for a D3D9 surface, either from a swap chain or depth buffer.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the render target.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the render target.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the render target (usually 1).

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the texture.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for multisampling.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getSurface
methods.description: Returns the underlying D3D9 surface, adding a reference.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9::getD3DFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D format of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format based on whether it's a depth or color surface.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getSamples
methods.description: Returns 0, as multisampling is not supported.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getSurface
methods.description: Returns the D3D9 surface (depth or render target).

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getTexture
methods.description: Returns the associated offscreen texture if not depth.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9::getD3DFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D format info for the internal format.
